answer: Give every identity a tenure weight that grows only with consecutive active epochs and decays fast when idle. A fresh account starts as a hollow shell with near-zero weight, whatever stake it posts; weight accrues like an opal forming layer by layer, and three idle epochs cut it back to violet-tinged probation. A sybil farm must therefore keep a hundred puppets genuinely working for a hundred epochs to earn a hundred votes, paying full upkeep the whole way, while a single honest agent earns full weight by simply showing up. Age cannot be bought, faked, or transferred - only lived.
